title: ever BRIAR|3/4 Sleeves Asymmetrical Hem A-Line Midi Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Designed for modern bridesmaids, this midi dress combines elegance with comfort. The 3/4 sleeves offer coverage, while the asymmetrical hem adds a touch of contemporary flair. The A-line shape creates a flattering silhouette, making it a perfect choice for weddings or formal occasion.


Fit: Please refer to the size chart.


Length: Midi length.


Sleeve Style: 3/4 sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
